description_en: Queries the statistics on the resources in an account group by region
description_zh: 从地域维度查询指定账号组内资源的统计结果
name: GetAggregateResourceCountsGroupByRegion

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

For more information about how to obtain the type of a resource, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

关于如何获取资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the folder in the resource directory. For more information about how to obtain the ID of a folder, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/111223.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源目录的资源夹ID。关于如何获取资源目录的资源夹ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/111223.html
parameters.name: folder_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resources in the account group belong.

You can use either the ResourceAccountId or ResourceOwnerId parameter. We recommend that you use the ResourceAccountId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
账号组内待查询资源所属的阿里云账号ID。
参数ResourceAccountId和ResourceOwnerId二选一，推荐使用本参数
parameters.name: resource_account_id

DiscoveredResourceCountsSummary.description_en: The ID of the region by which statistics are collected

GroupName.description_en:
The dimension by which statistics are collected.

In most cases, the `Region` parameter is returned instead of the GroupName parameter
GroupName.description_zh:
分组统计的名称。

通常不用该参数，使用`Region`

Region.description_en: The ID of the region by which statistics are collected

ResourceCount.description_en: The total number of resources in the region
